title: Junior Frontend Developer
description: Entry-level frontend position focused on core web fundamentals, CSS styling, foundational JavaScript, basic TypeScript, and initial framework component development.

skills.rationale: Essential knowledge of HTML semantics, DOM manipulation, forms, and responsive design is critical for any junior engineer.
Strong grasp of the box model, Flexbox layout, CSS selectors, and basic positioning is required to build reliable UI layouts.
Solid understanding of JS variables, scoping, functions, array/object manipulation, and DOM events.
Ability to create standard components in React or Vue, handle props, state, and client-side routing.
Familiarity with package managers (npm/yarn/pnpm), linters/formatters, git workflows, and dev servers.
Basic TypeScript types, interface definitions, and working in strict mode.
Writing basic unit tests and component tests following AAA patterns.
Basic page creation and static generation in Next.js or Nuxt.
Awareness of XSS prevention, CORS errors, and Core Web Vitals metrics.

scoring.description: Each skill score is multiplied by its importance weight. Final score is sum divided by sum of weights.

not_ready.label: Not Ready
not_ready.description: Significant gaps in web foundations and core frontend skills.

developing.label: Developing
developing.description: Basic HTML/CSS understanding, but needs guidance on JavaScript logic and framework development.

approaching.label: Approaching Ready
approaching.description: Solid core web fundamentals and component creation, working towards independent task delivery.

ready.label: Ready
ready.description: Meets all junior expectations: builds clean, accessible, responsive components with proper typing and tests.

exceeds.label: Exceeds Expectations
exceeds.description: Exceeds junior expectations with early mid-level proficiency in state management and testing.
